definitions.explanation: A strong, deliberate decision to do something, often involving significant commitment.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}を{決意|けつい}した。
examples.english: I made up my mind to study abroad.

examples.japanese: {固|かた}い{決意|けつい}で{試験|しけん}に{臨|のぞ}んだ。
examples.english: I faced the exam with firm determination.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{決意|けつい}は{揺|ゆ}らがなかった。

notes:
FORMATION:
{決|けつ} (decide) + {意|い} (will/intention)

VERB FORMS:
・{決意|けつい}する - to make a resolution, to determine
・{決意|けつい}を{固|かた}める - to strengthen one's resolve

COLLOCATIONS:
・{固|かた}い{決意|けつい} - firm determination
・{決意|けつい}を{示|しめ}す - to show determination
・{決意|けつい}が{揺|ゆ}らぐ - determination wavers
・{決意|けつい}を{新|あら}たにする - to renew one's determination
・{決意|けつい}{表明|ひょうめい} - declaration of intent

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{決心|けっしん} - decision, determination (more emotional)
・{覚悟|かくご} - preparedness, resolution (involves accepting consequences)
・{意志|いし} - will, volition
